$comment: SECURITY DEFINER functions in public that anon or authenticated may execute. Checked by tools/check-security-definer.mjs (npm run audit:security-definer). rls-helper: returns only what the caller may do; rpc: must check the caller itself; public-token: callable before sign-in, guarded by a random access token or exposing no organisation data.

analysis_crosstab_metrics.reason: Analytics cross-tabulations (department × HAI type, agent × organism, …); same access as analysis_domain_metrics: Platform Owner or Hospital Admin / IPC Lead of the organisation.

analysis_domain_metrics.reason: Analytics aggregates; Platform Owner or Hospital Admin / IPC Lead of the organisation.

analysis_people_metrics.reason: Staff analytics; Platform Owner or Hospital Admin / IPC Lead; health data gated by view_occupational_health.

answer_committee_membership.reason: The invited member answers their own pending committee membership (user_id = auth.uid()).

archive_patient.reason: Archives a patient; requires delete_patient capability in the patient's department.

can_view_surveillance_record.reason: Answers only whether the caller may access the given organisation or department; used by RLS policies, which run with the caller's privileges and so need EXECUTE.

close_patient_admission.reason: Discharges an admission; requires edit_patient in the department.

committee_minutes_external_access.reason: Shows the minutes to a committee member without an account from the e-mailed link; only the SHA-256 of the random single-use token is stored.

committee_minutes_external_action.reason: Resend the e-mail link or record a signature on paper; requires finalize_committee_minutes on the committee.

committee_minutes_external_decide.reason: Records the approval or the request for changes of a member without an account, identified by the e-mailed single-use token; pending and unexpired only.

create_patient_admission.reason: Creates an admission; requires the patient capability in the department.

current_demo_access.reason: Returns only the signed-in evaluator's own Demo organizations with their dates, state and whether access is open; reads entitlements the evaluator cannot select directly.

current_user_is_demo_admin.reason: Answers only whether the caller is the Hospital Admin of the given Demo organisation; used by the read-only Demo policies on antimicrobial therapy.

current_user_is_platform_owner.reason: Answers only whether the caller may access the given organisation or department; used by RLS policies, which run with the caller's privileges and so need EXECUTE.

current_user_manages_department_control.reason: Answers only whether the caller is a department manager and the given control is a department control assigned only to the caller's departments; used by control RLS policies, which run with the caller's privileges and so need EXECUTE.

delete_patient_admission.reason: Deletes one admission with a written reason (audit log); requires delete_patient capability; refuses the patient's last admission and admissions with surveillance episodes.

demo_rate_evaluation_step.reason: Stores the signed-in Demo member's own rating (1-5) and comment for an evaluation-guide scenario or the whole guide; refuses anyone who is not an active member of that Demo.

demo_request_application.reason: Stores an evaluator's "I want the application" request, writes it to the audit log and queues an e-mail to every Platform Owner; members of a Demo only, at most three a day.

demo_set_evaluation_step.reason: Marks an evaluation-guide step done or not done for the signed-in member of a Demo organization only; refuses anyone who is not an active member of that Demo.

demo_submit_scenario_feedback.reason: Stores the signed-in Demo member's own questionnaire (usefulness, ease and clarity 1-5, time taken, comment) for an evaluation-guide scenario or the whole guide; refuses anyone who is not an active member of that Demo.

demo_switch_my_role.reason: Lets a member of a Demo organization switch their own role (and department scope) so the database shows exactly what that role sees; refuses any organization that is not a Demo and any role outside the previewable system roles.

department_register_sync.reason: Creates or extends the data table of a department register (one column per field) from its definition; Platform Owner, Hospital Admin, Quality Manager or manage_quality of the register's organisation.

document_acknowledgement_members.reason: Read-acknowledgement audience for controlled documents; returns members only to the Hospital Admin, IPC Lead or Quality Manager of the organisation (the roles that distribute documents and read all acknowledgements).

employee_admin_history.reason: Employee audit trail; HR / occupational health / admin roles or capabilities of the employee's organisation.

get_platform_maintenance_notice.reason: Returns the platform maintenance banner shown to every signed-in user; no organisation data.

has_org_role.reason: Answers only whether the caller may access the given organisation or department; used by RLS policies, which run with the caller's privileges and so need EXECUTE.

is_org_admin.reason: Answers only whether the caller may access the given organisation or department; used by RLS policies, which run with the caller's privileges and so need EXECUTE.

is_org_member.reason: Answers only whether the caller may access the given organisation or department; used by RLS policies, which run with the caller's privileges and so need EXECUTE.

platform_cancel_organization_deletion.reason: Cancels a scheduled organization deletion and reopens access; Platform Owner only, audited.

platform_convert_demo_tx.reason: Turns a Demo into a real organization in one transaction, clearing its synthetic data first; Platform Owner only, audited.

platform_demo_purge_candidates.reason: Lists the Demos due for automatic deletion under the platform setting; returns nothing unless the caller is the Platform Owner.

platform_demo_seed_member.reason: Gives a new Demo evaluator their own committee membership, minutes approval and document distributions; Platform Owner only, Demo organisations only.

platform_extend_demo.reason: Extends a Demo to a new end date (and reopens an expired one); Platform Owner only, audited.

platform_open_owner_demo.reason: Creates (once) and fills the Platform Owner's own Demo organization with the Demo data pack; Platform Owner only.

platform_organization_deletion_impact.reason: Counts what deleting the given organisations would remove (rows, files, accounts); Platform Owner only.

platform_purge_organization_tx.reason: Purges an organisation; Platform Owner only, needs a single-use ticket issued by the platform-delete-organizations Edge Function after a password re-check, plus the organisation code.

platform_report_summary.reason: Report counts; Platform Owner or Hospital Admin / IPC Lead of the organisation.

platform_reset_demo_organization.reason: Clears a Demo organisation's data and writes the Demo data pack again; Platform Owner only, refuses any organisation that is not a Demo.

platform_schedule_organization_deletion.reason: Schedules a real organization's deletion after the grace period and closes its access; needs a recent export or a waiver reason; Platform Owner only, audited.

public_login_notice.reason: Maintenance notice and support e-mail on the login screen, before sign-in; exposes no organisation data.

queue_training_invitation.reason: Queues a training invitation e-mail; manage_training or admin roles of the organisation.

record_runtime_event.reason: Writes a runtime event for an organisation the caller is an active member of.

regulation_approve.reason: Approves a regulation's draft as its next edition; checks private.can_manage_regulations for the regulation's organisation and requires both signatures (administrator, infection control lead) for the draft's current revision.

regulation_sign.reason: Signs a regulation's draft in a role; checks private.can_sign_regulation (Hospital Admin as administrator, IPC Lead as infection_lead, or Platform Owner). The signatures table has no write grant.

set_member_screen_guides.reason: Sets whether one member of an organization sees the screen guides; checks that the caller is the platform owner or that organization's admin and writes the audit log.

set_organization_branding.reason: Sets the organisation's logo and report header; Platform Owner or organisation admin.

set_organization_idle_lock.reason: Sets the organisation's screen lock after inactivity; Platform Owner or organisation admin.

set_organization_screen_guides.reason: Turns the screen guides on, off or back to the default for one organization; checks that the caller is the platform owner or that organization's admin and writes the audit log.

submit_committee_minutes.reason: Submits minutes for approval; requires finalize_committee_minutes on the committee; members without an account get an e-mail link or a paper signature.

survey_public.reason: Shows a satisfaction survey's questions and departments to a respondent without an account, from the survey's public link (QR poster); nothing about other responses.

survey_submit.reason: Records one anonymous response through the survey's public link: open surveys only, answers checked against the questions, departments the survey covers, at most 60 a minute.

training_email_access.reason: Opens a training from the e-mailed link; the one-time random access token identifies the assignment; answers are stripped.

training_submit_evaluation.reason: Submits the evaluation from the e-mailed link, identified by the access token.

transfer_patient_admission.reason: Transfers an admission; requires the patient capability in both departments.

update_organization_profile.reason: Edits the organisation profile; Platform Owner or organisation admin.
